lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Hey, Muse.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Can I ask you something?
What is it?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: How do you usually keep your energy up?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Especially when you're up on the surface for missions.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I doubt you're getting enough sleep or enough food.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: And after living like that for a while,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I can't imagine it's easy going back to a normal routine in the Ark.
Why do you ask?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I mean, I'm really grateful things have been going well lately,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: but I've been insanely busy.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Trying to make time for both practice and sleep hasn't exactly been easy.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: And that got me thinking.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I can always cut back on sleep, practice less, or move things around if I have to.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Worst case, I just reschedule something.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: But you don't really have the luxury of making those kinds of choices, right?
No, I don't.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: And yet,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: you're always busy taking care of the other Nikkes,

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: but I've never really seen you look exhausted or anything.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Honestly, that's pretty impressive.
I guess I've always had pretty good stamina.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: You're saying you were born that way?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: But you're still human, tho...

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Do you take vitamins or anything like that?
Nah, I don't.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Then do you get IVs a lot?
Nope.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: So you're just naturally like that?

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Damn, that's impressive.
I make sure to get plenty of rest whenever I'm at the Ark or the Outpost.
Up on the surface, letting your guard down can get you killed. Maybe that's what keeps me going.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Fair point.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I shouldn't have compared those in the first place.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: That was a pretty weird thing to ask.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: Thanks for answering anyway.
It's fine, haha.
Just don't overdo it either, Prika.

lines.speaker: prika_i
lines.text: I won't, thanks!
